title: 5.5 Organic Chemistry Nitrogen Compounds · Topic 19
text:
本页严格按 Pearson Edexcel International Advanced Level Chemistry specification 的 Topic 19: Organic Nitrogen Compounds: Amines, Amides, Amino Acids and Proteins（19.1–19.12） 编排，主要依据项目内的 5.5 Organic Chemistry Nitrogen Compounds.pdf.pdf。解释采用中文，专业词汇保留 English，便于和 reaction conditions、polymer structures 及 exam wording 对照。


学完本章后，你应该能够：

name and draw amines、amides 和 amino acids；
explain primary aliphatic amine reactions、basicity、preparation 和 copper(II) complex formation；
prepare phenylamine from nitrobenzene，并描述 diazotization / azo-dye coupling；
prepare amides from acyl chlorides and ammonia / amines；
distinguish condensation polymerisation from addition polymerisation，并画 repeat units；
explain polyamides、proteins、poly(ethenol) 的 properties and uses；
explain amino-acid zwitterions、isoelectric point、optical activity 和 peptide-bond formation；
plan Core Practical 15: analysis of inorganic and organic unknowns。






Amines 可看作 ammonia 的 derivatives，其中 one or more H atoms 被 alkyl / aryl groups 替代。Classification 按 attached carbon groups on nitrogen，不是像 alcohol / halogenoalkane 那样按 carbon atom 分类：

primary amine：\(\ce{RNH2}\)；
secondary amine：\(\ce{R2NH}\)；
tertiary amine：\(\ce{R3N}\)。

R 是 alkyl group 时称 aliphatic amine；R 是 phenyl / aryl group 时称 aromatic amine。
Common names 用 alkyl / aryl prefix + -amine，例如 methylamine、ethylamine、phenylamine。Systematic name 可用 amino- prefix，例如 aminomethane、aminoethane、aminobenzene。



Classification of ammonia and amines





Names and formulae of amines





Amides 含有 \(\ce{-CONR2}\) functional group，可由 carboxylic acid derivatives 与 ammonia / amines 形成。Amide nitrogen 上有多少 carbon substituents，就可分类为 primary、secondary 或 tertiary amide：

ethanamide：\(\ce{CH3CONH2}\)；
N-propylethanamide：\(\ce{CH3CONHCH2CH2CH3}\)；
N-methyl-N-propylethanamide：\(\ce{CH3CON(CH3)(CH2CH2CH3)}\)。

Secondary / tertiary amide 的 N-substituent 用 N- 标记，多个 substituents 按 alphabetical order 命名。



General structure of an amide





Amino acids 同时含有 basic amino group \(\ce{-NH2}\) 和 acidic carboxylic acid group \(\ce{-COOH}\)，因此是 amphoteric。Topic 19 的 protein-building amino acids 是 2-amino carboxylic acids，general formula：
\[
\ce{RCH(NH2)COOH}
\]
R group 决定 amino acid 的 properties，可为 acidic、basic 或 neutral。Naturally occurring proteins 使用约 20 种不同 amino-acid building blocks。



General structure of an amino acid





Examples of amino-acid R groups








Primary aliphatic amines 的 first members 与 water miscible，因为 nitrogen lone pair 和 water 可形成 hydrogen bonds。Hydrocarbon chain 变长时，water solubility decreases。Butylamine 在 water 中可形成 alkaline solution：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 + H2O <=> CH3CH2CH2CH2NH3+ + OH-}
\]
Amine 是 Brønsted-Lowry base：nitrogen lone pair donate a pair of electrons to \(\ce{H+}\)，形成 dative covalent bond。



Protonation of ammonia and amines





Basicity 取决于 nitrogen lone pair 接受 proton 的 availability：

alkyl groups 有 positive inductive effect，push electron density towards nitrogen，使 primary aliphatic amines 比 ammonia stronger bases；
secondary amines 有更多 electron-releasing alkyl groups，通常比 primary amines 更 basic；
phenylamine 中 nitrogen lone pair 可 delocalise into benzene ring，因此 lone pair less available，aromatic amine 比 aliphatic amine weaker base。

因此 ethylamine 比 phenylamine 更容易 accept \(\ce{H+}\)。Basicity 讨论必须说明 electron density / lone-pair availability，而不是只背结论。



Factors affecting amine basicity





Ethylamine is more basic than phenylamine





Amines 与 strong acids 反应形成 ionic ammonium salts：
\[
\ce{CH3NH2(aq) + HCl(aq) -> CH3NH3+Cl-(aq)}
\]
Evaporating water 可得到 crystalline ammonium salt。Salt 通常比 free amine 更 water-soluble；加入 aqueous \(\ce{NaOH}\) 可 deprotonate ammonium salt，释放 free amine。






Amine nitrogen 的 lone pair attack electron-deficient carbon in halogenoalkane，发生 substitution：
\[
\ce{RNH2 + R'X -> RNHR' + HX}
\]
Primary amine 生成 secondary amine；secondary amine 仍有 lone pair，可继续 react：
\[
\ce{R2NH + R'X -> R2NR' + HX}
\]
Tertiary amine 再与 halogenoalkane 反应生成 quaternary ammonium salt：
\[
\ce{R3N + R'X -> [R3R'N]+X-}
\]
因此使用 excess ammonia 有助于提高 primary amine proportion；否则会发生 over-alkylation mixture。



Reaction of a halogenoalkane with ammonia








Primary amines 与 ethanoyl chloride 发生 addition-elimination，生成 N-substituted amide 和 HCl：
\[
\ce{CH3COCl + CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 -> CH3CONHCH2CH2CH2CH3 + HCl}
\]
Amine 的 nitrogen lone pair attack acyl carbon；\(\ce{Cl-}\) leaves，最终形成 amide link。Specification 不要求这里的 detailed mechanism，但要能写 product 和 equation。






Butylamine 可作 ligand，先使 hexaaquacopper(II) 形成 hydroxide precipitate，再在 excess amine 中 ligand exchange：
\[
\ce{[Cu(H2O)6]^{2+} + 2CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 -> [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2](s) + 2CH3CH2CH2CH2NH3+}
\]
Excess butylamine：
\[
\ce{[Cu(H2O)4(OH)2](s) + 4CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 -> [Cu(BuNH2)4(H2O)2]^{2+} + 2H2O + 2OH-}
\]
Observation：pale blue precipitate，then precipitate dissolves in excess butylamine to give deep blue solution。






Use excess hot ethanolic ammonia under pressure，通过 nucleophilic substitution：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2Cl + 2NH3 ->[ethanolic][heat, pressure] CH3CH2NH2 + NH4Cl}
\]
Excess ammonia reduces further alkylation of the primary amine。



Nitrile 的 \(\ce{-C#N}\) group 可被 reduced 为 primary amine，且 chain length 比 halogenoalkane starting material 多一个 carbon：
\[
\ce{RC#N + 4[H] -> RCH2NH2}
\]
Reagents / conditions：

\(\ce{LiAlH4}\) in dry ether；或
hydrogen gas over nickel catalyst，heat。

例如 ethanenitrile \(→\) ethylamine。



Reduction of a nitrile to a primary amine








Phenylamine（aniline / aminobenzene）可由 nitrobenzene reduction 制备：
Stage 1：reduction in acidic medium

nitrobenzene + tin + concentrated hydrochloric acid；
heat under reflux；
product 是 phenylammonium ion / salt，因为 medium acidic。

Stage 2：liberation of free amine

add excess aqueous \(\ce{NaOH}\)；
phenylammonium ion deprotonates，生成 phenylamine；
tin hydroxide precipitates 也形成。

Stage 3：purification
Steam distillation、salt-out with \(\ce{NaCl}\)、separating funnel extraction with ether，最后 distil phenylamine fraction（约 180-185 °C）。



Two-stage reduction of nitrobenzene to phenylamine





Azo compounds 含有 \(\ce{-N=N-}\) group，常用于 dyes。Azo dye synthesis 的关键步骤：

Generate nitrous acid in situ： \[\ce{NaNO2 + HCl -> HNO2 + NaCl}\]
Diazotization：phenylamine 与 nitrous acid + dilute HCl 反应，temperature must remain below \(10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\)，形成 benzenediazonium chloride；
Coupling：diazonium ion 作为 electrophile，在 alkaline phenol 的 para position 发生 electrophilic coupling，形成 brightly coloured azo dye。




Azo group





Conditions for azo compound formation





Diazotization 可简化表示为：
\[
\ce{C6H5NH2 + HNO2 + HCl -> C6H5N2+Cl- + 2H2O}
\]
Coupling reaction 的核心是：diazonium ion 的 \(\ce{N#N+}\) end 是 electrophilic，phenoxide / activated phenol ring 的 electron density attack it，形成 extended delocalised system。Alkaline condition 使 phenol deprotonate，增加 ring reactivity。Azo bridge 与两侧 aromatic rings 共轭，使 product strongly coloured and stable。



Diazotization of phenylamine





Coupling of benzenediazonium chloride with phenol








Acyl chloride 与 ammonia / primary amine / secondary amine 发生 condensation / nucleophilic acyl substitution，形成 amide 并 eliminate HCl：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2COCl + NH3 -> CH3CH2CONH2 + HCl}
\]
实际上 ammonia 会 neutralise HCl，所以 overall equation 常写：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2COCl + 2NH3 -> CH3CH2CONH2 + NH4Cl}
\]
With methylamine：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2COCl + 2CH3NH2 -> CH3CH2CONHCH3 + CH3NH3Cl}
\]
Ammonia gives unsubstituted primary amide；primary / secondary amine gives N-substituted amide。



Amide formation from an acyl chloride











Condensation polymerisation：bifunctional monomers repeatedly react，形成 polymer，同时 each link eliminates a small molecule，通常 \(\ce{H2O}\) 或 \(\ce{HCl}\)。

diol + dicarboxylic acid \(→\) polyester + water；
diamine + dicarboxylic acid \(→\) polyamide + water；
diamine + dioyl dichloride \(→\) polyamide + HCl；
amino acids \(→\) polypeptides / proteins + water。

Ester link 是 \(\ce{-COO-}\)；amide / peptide link 是 \(\ce{-CONH-}\)。



A polyester chain





Diol and dicarboxylic acid monomers





Ethane-1,2-diol + benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid（terephthalic acid）可形成 poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET)，又称 Terylene / Dacron。每形成 one ester link，remove one water molecule。
一个 molecule 同时带有 \(\ce{-OH}\) 和 \(\ce{-COOH}\) 时，称 hydroxycarboxylic acid，也可 self-condense 形成 polyester，例如 2-hydroxybutanoic acid。



Formation of PET





Polyester from a hydroxycarboxylic acid








Polyamide 需要 diamine + dicarboxylic acid / dioyl dichloride。Example Nylon-6,6：

1,6-diaminohexane；
hexane-1,6-dioic acid（adipic acid）或 hexanedioyl dichloride；
repeat link：\(\ce{-CONH-}\)。

Kevlar 使用 1,4-diaminobenzene 和 benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid，aromatic rings 和 extensive hydrogen bonding 使 polymer strong、stiff、heat-resistant。



Amide link





Polyamide monomers





Polyamide formation





Amino-acid side-chain concept





Amino acids 通过 amine group 与另一 amino acid 的 carboxylic acid group condensation，形成 peptide bond，即 amide bond：
\[
\ce{H2NCH(R)COOH + H2NCH(R')COOH -> H2NCH(R)CONHCH(R')COOH + H2O}
\]
Two amino acids form dipeptide；many form polypeptide；protein 是 folded biological polypeptide / polymer。每个 terminal end 仍有可继续 reaction 的 functional group。



Dipeptide formation








Addition polymerisation 使用 alkene monomers：\(\ce{C=C}\) bond opens，形成 saturated C-C polymer backbone；没有 small molecule eliminated。画 repeat unit 时：

identify the two carbon atoms of original C=C；
change C=C to C-C single bond；
keep substituents attached to the same carbon；
put the repeat unit in square brackets with \(n\)。

例如 ethene：
\[
\ce{nCH2=CH2 -> [-CH2-CH2-]_{n}}
\]
Chloroethene follows the same rule，形成 poly(chloroethene)。



Poly(ethene) repeat unit





Polymer repeat-unit deduction example





Deducing an alkene monomer from a polymer





More repeating-unit examples





Specification 要求 addition polymers including poly(propenamide) 和 poly(ethenol)，并能画 repeat units。
\[
\ce{nCH2=CHCONH2 -> [-CH2-CH(CONH2)-]_{n}}
\]
Poly(ethenol) 的 repeat unit：
\[
\ce{nCH2=CHOH -> [-CH2-CH(OH)-]_{n}}
\]
Poly(ethenol) 通常不是直接由 ethenol monomer 制备，而是先形成 poly(ethyl ethanoate)，再与 methanol 发生 ester exchange，把 ester groups 转换为 \(\ce{-OH}\) groups。OH groups 可与 water hydrogen bond，因而 polymer solubility 取决于 ester-to-OH conversion degree。



Poly(ethenol) formation





Poly(prop-2-enoic acid) and related repeat unit





Prop-2-enoic acid monomer





Poly(ethene-1,2-diol)




Worked example · identify monomers and repeat units
看到 addition polymer structure 时，先 locate two-carbon backbone repeat：

polymer backbone 中每两个 carbon 对应 original alkene；
remove substituents mentally，restore C=C；
repeat unit 中的 branch / functional group 保持 attached to the same carbon。

例如 repeat unit \(\ce{[-CH2-CH(OH)-]_{n}}\) 的 monomer 是 ethenol，polymer 是 poly(ethenol)。



Polyamides / nylons：

amide links form hydrogen bonds between chains；
chains 可较整齐排列，polymer semi-crystalline；
generally tough，具有 thermal / chemical resistance；
absorb moisture，water content 增加 impact resistance / flexibility，但可能降低 strength / stiffness；
可制成 strong fibres、clothing、food packaging 和 boil-in-the-bag film。

Kevlar 的 rigid aromatic structure 和 hydrogen bonding 使它 strong、light、fire-resistant，可用于 bullet-proof vests。
Poly(ethenol)：

many \(\ce{-OH}\) groups form hydrogen bonds with water；
more ester groups converted to \(\ce{-OH}\)，water solubility 越高；
soluble laundry bags 和 liquid-detergent capsules（liquitabs）利用其 water solubility。

Nylon-6,6 structure





Poly(ethenol) ester exchange





Poly(ethenol) water solubility








Amino acid 内部可发生 proton transfer，形成 zwitterion：同一个 molecule 同时有 positive \(\ce{-NH3+}\) 和 negative \(\ce{-COO-}\) charges：
\[
\ce{H2NCH(R)COOH <=> ^+H3NCH(R)COO-}
\]
Zwitterions 有 strong ionic attractions，因此 amino acids 通常是 soluble crystalline solids，并表现 amphoteric behaviour。



Formation of an amino-acid zwitterion





在 acidic solution（pH lowered），zwitterion 的 \(\ce{-COO-}\) accept \(\ce{H+}\)，形成 positively charged ion：
\[
\ce{^+H3NCH(R)COO- + H+ -> ^+H3NCH(R)COOH}
\]
在 alkaline solution（pH raised），\(\ce{-NH3+}\) donate \(\ce{H+}\)，形成 negatively charged ion：
\[
\ce{^+H3NCH(R)COO- + OH- -> H2NCH(R)COO- + H2O}
\]
因此 amino-acid solution 可 resist small pH changes，表现为 buffer。Isoelectric point 是 neutral zwitterion form dominates 的 pH。



Amino-acid acid-base reactions





Amino-acid isoelectric point





Amino acids 也表现 amine / carboxylic acid 的 characteristic reactions：

与 HCl 反应形成 ammonium salt：\(\ce{H2NCH(R)COOH + HCl -> ^+H3NCH(R)COOHCl-}\)；
与 NaOH 反应形成 sodium carboxylate：\(\ce{H2NCH(R)COOH + NaOH -> H2NCH(R)COO-Na+ + H2O}\)；
与 alcohol / acid catalyst 加热可 esterify carboxyl group。

Almost all 2-amino acids 有 chiral centre，因此 enantiomeric aqueous solutions rotate plane-polarised monochromatic light：\((+)\) dextrorotatory 或 \((-)\) laevorotatory。Glycine 的 central carbon 是 \(\ce{CH2}\)，没有 chiral centre；laboratory synthesis of a chiral amino acid 通常得到 racemic mixture。






一个 amino acid 的 \(\ce{-NH2}\) 与另一个 amino acid 的 \(\ce{-COOH}\) 发生 condensation，eliminate \(\ce{H2O}\)，形成 peptide bond / amide link：
\[
\ce{H2NCH(R)COOH + H2NCH(R')COOH -> H2NCH(R)CONHCH(R')COOH + H2O}
\]
Two amino acids \(→\) dipeptide；more than two \(→\) polypeptide；proteins 是由 amino-acid monomers 组成的 biological polymers。画 peptide structure 时必须保留正确的 N-to-C direction 和 terminal groups。



Dipeptide and peptide-bond formation








Core Practical 15 是 analysis of some inorganic and organic unknowns。A robust analysis workflow：

先记录 physical state、colour、odour（不可直接闻，使用 wafting）和 solubility；
对 inorganic unknown 做 flame / ion / anion / gas tests，写 observations 和 ionic equations；
对 organic unknown 通过 solubility、acid-base behaviour、functional-group tests、precipitate / colour change 逐步 narrow possibilities；
amine 可用 acid 形成 ammonium salt，carboxylic acid 可与 carbonate 释放 \(\ce{CO2}\)，carbonyl 可用 2,4-DNPH / Tollens 等 prior-topic tests；
使用 spectra / melting or boiling temperature / chromatography data 作 supporting evidence；
设计 controls、repeat measurements，区分 observation、inference 和 final identification；
根据 hazards 使用 fume hood、goggles、gloves，避免直接接触 volatile amines、phenylamine、strong acids 和 diazonium mixtures。

实验报告应明确写出 reagent、condition、observation、equation 和 conclusion，不能只写 “positive test”。






能区分 primary / secondary / tertiary amines，并命名 amines、amides 和 amino acids。
能解释 amines 与 water、acids、halogenoalkanes、ethanoyl chloride 和 \(\ce{Cu^{2+}}\) 的 reactions。
能比较 ammonia、primary aliphatic amine 和 phenylamine basicity，使用 inductive effect / delocalisation 解释。
能写 primary aliphatic amine 从 halogenoalkane 和 nitrile 的 preparation conditions。
能写 nitrobenzene \(→\) phenylamine 的 Sn / conc HCl reflux、NaOH liberation 和 purification steps。
能描述 nitrous acid formation、diazotization、低温 control 和 phenol coupling to azo dye。
能写 acyl chloride + ammonia / amine 的 amide formation，并处理 HCl / ammonium salt stoichiometry。
能区分 condensation / addition polymerisation，并画 polyamide、poly(propenamide) 和 poly(ethenol) repeat units。
能解释 polyamide hydrogen bonding、Kevlar / Nylon properties 和 poly(ethenol) water solubility / uses。
能画 amino-acid zwitterion，解释 amphoteric / buffer behaviour、isoelectric point 和 optical activity。
能写 peptide-bond condensation，并识别 dipeptide、polypeptide 和 protein。
能按 Core Practical 15 的逻辑完成 unknown analysis、controls、safety 和 evidence-based conclusion。

title: 5.5 Organic Chemistry Nitrogen Compounds · Topic 19
text:
Amines 可看作 ammonia 的 derivatives，其中 one or more H atoms 被 alkyl / aryl groups 替代。Classification 按 attached carbon groups on nitrogen，不是像 alcohol / halogenoalkane 那样按 carbon atom 分类：

primary amine：\(\ce{RNH2}\)；
secondary amine：\(\ce{R2NH}\)；
tertiary amine：\(\ce{R3N}\)。

R 是 alkyl group 时称 aliphatic amine；R 是 phenyl / aryl group 时称 aromatic amine。
Common names 用 alkyl / aryl prefix + -amine，例如 methylamine、ethylamine、phenylamine。Systematic name 可用 amino- prefix，例如 aminomethane、aminoethane、aminobenzene。



Classification of ammonia and amines





Names and formulae of amines





Amides 含有 \(\ce{-CONR2}\) functional group，可由 carboxylic acid derivatives 与 ammonia / amines 形成。Amide nitrogen 上有多少 carbon substituents，就可分类为 primary、secondary 或 tertiary amide：

ethanamide：\(\ce{CH3CONH2}\)；
N-propylethanamide：\(\ce{CH3CONHCH2CH2CH3}\)；
N-methyl-N-propylethanamide：\(\ce{CH3CON(CH3)(CH2CH2CH3)}\)。

Secondary / tertiary amide 的 N-substituent 用 N- 标记，多个 substituents 按 alphabetical order 命名。



General structure of an amide





Amino acids 同时含有 basic amino group \(\ce{-NH2}\) 和 acidic carboxylic acid group \(\ce{-COOH}\)，因此是 amphoteric。Topic 19 的 protein-building amino acids 是 2-amino carboxylic acids，general formula：
\[
\ce{RCH(NH2)COOH}
\]
R group 决定 amino acid 的 properties，可为 acidic、basic 或 neutral。Naturally occurring proteins 使用约 20 种不同 amino-acid building blocks。



General structure of an amino acid





Examples of amino-acid R groups

title: 5.5 Organic Chemistry Nitrogen Compounds · Topic 19
text:
Primary aliphatic amines 的 first members 与 water miscible，因为 nitrogen lone pair 和 water 可形成 hydrogen bonds。Hydrocarbon chain 变长时，water solubility decreases。Butylamine 在 water 中可形成 alkaline solution：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 + H2O <=> CH3CH2CH2CH2NH3+ + OH-}
\]
Amine 是 Brønsted-Lowry base：nitrogen lone pair donate a pair of electrons to \(\ce{H+}\)，形成 dative covalent bond。



Protonation of ammonia and amines





Basicity 取决于 nitrogen lone pair 接受 proton 的 availability：

alkyl groups 有 positive inductive effect，push electron density towards nitrogen，使 primary aliphatic amines 比 ammonia stronger bases；
secondary amines 有更多 electron-releasing alkyl groups，通常比 primary amines 更 basic；
phenylamine 中 nitrogen lone pair 可 delocalise into benzene ring，因此 lone pair less available，aromatic amine 比 aliphatic amine weaker base。

因此 ethylamine 比 phenylamine 更容易 accept \(\ce{H+}\)。Basicity 讨论必须说明 electron density / lone-pair availability，而不是只背结论。



Factors affecting amine basicity





Ethylamine is more basic than phenylamine





Amines 与 strong acids 反应形成 ionic ammonium salts：
\[
\ce{CH3NH2(aq) + HCl(aq) -> CH3NH3+Cl-(aq)}
\]
Evaporating water 可得到 crystalline ammonium salt。Salt 通常比 free amine 更 water-soluble；加入 aqueous \(\ce{NaOH}\) 可 deprotonate ammonium salt，释放 free amine。






Amine nitrogen 的 lone pair attack electron-deficient carbon in halogenoalkane，发生 substitution：
\[
\ce{RNH2 + R'X -> RNHR' + HX}
\]
Primary amine 生成 secondary amine；secondary amine 仍有 lone pair，可继续 react：
\[
\ce{R2NH + R'X -> R2NR' + HX}
\]
Tertiary amine 再与 halogenoalkane 反应生成 quaternary ammonium salt：
\[
\ce{R3N + R'X -> [R3R'N]+X-}
\]
因此使用 excess ammonia 有助于提高 primary amine proportion；否则会发生 over-alkylation mixture。



Reaction of a halogenoalkane with ammonia








Primary amines 与 ethanoyl chloride 发生 addition-elimination，生成 N-substituted amide 和 HCl：
\[
\ce{CH3COCl + CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 -> CH3CONHCH2CH2CH2CH3 + HCl}
\]
Amine 的 nitrogen lone pair attack acyl carbon；\(\ce{Cl-}\) leaves，最终形成 amide link。Specification 不要求这里的 detailed mechanism，但要能写 product 和 equation。






Butylamine 可作 ligand，先使 hexaaquacopper(II) 形成 hydroxide precipitate，再在 excess amine 中 ligand exchange：
\[
\ce{[Cu(H2O)6]^{2+} + 2CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 -> [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2](s) + 2CH3CH2CH2CH2NH3+}
\]
Excess butylamine：
\[
\ce{[Cu(H2O)4(OH)2](s) + 4CH3CH2CH2CH2NH2 -> [Cu(BuNH2)4(H2O)2]^{2+} + 2H2O + 2OH-}
\]
Observation：pale blue precipitate，then precipitate dissolves in excess butylamine to give deep blue solution。

\]

\(\ce{LiAlH4}\) in dry ether；或
hydrogen gas over nickel catalyst，heat。

title: 5.5 Organic Chemistry Nitrogen Compounds · Topic 19
text:
Phenylamine（aniline / aminobenzene）可由 nitrobenzene reduction 制备：
Stage 1：reduction in acidic medium

nitrobenzene + tin + concentrated hydrochloric acid；
heat under reflux；
product 是 phenylammonium ion / salt，因为 medium acidic。

Stage 2：liberation of free amine

add excess aqueous \(\ce{NaOH}\)；
phenylammonium ion deprotonates，生成 phenylamine；
tin hydroxide precipitates 也形成。

Stage 3：purification
Steam distillation、salt-out with \(\ce{NaCl}\)、separating funnel extraction with ether，最后 distil phenylamine fraction（约 180-185 °C）。



Two-stage reduction of nitrobenzene to phenylamine





Azo compounds 含有 \(\ce{-N=N-}\) group，常用于 dyes。Azo dye synthesis 的关键步骤：

Generate nitrous acid in situ： \[\ce{NaNO2 + HCl -> HNO2 + NaCl}\]
Diazotization：phenylamine 与 nitrous acid + dilute HCl 反应，temperature must remain below \(10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\)，形成 benzenediazonium chloride；
Coupling：diazonium ion 作为 electrophile，在 alkaline phenol 的 para position 发生 electrophilic coupling，形成 brightly coloured azo dye。




Azo group





Conditions for azo compound formation





Diazotization 可简化表示为：
\[
\ce{C6H5NH2 + HNO2 + HCl -> C6H5N2+Cl- + 2H2O}
\]
Coupling reaction 的核心是：diazonium ion 的 \(\ce{N#N+}\) end 是 electrophilic，phenoxide / activated phenol ring 的 electron density attack it，形成 extended delocalised system。Alkaline condition 使 phenol deprotonate，增加 ring reactivity。Azo bridge 与两侧 aromatic rings 共轭，使 product strongly coloured and stable。



Diazotization of phenylamine





Coupling of benzenediazonium chloride with phenol

title: 5.5 Organic Chemistry Nitrogen Compounds · Topic 19
text:
Acyl chloride 与 ammonia / primary amine / secondary amine 发生 condensation / nucleophilic acyl substitution，形成 amide 并 eliminate HCl：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2COCl + NH3 -> CH3CH2CONH2 + HCl}
\]
实际上 ammonia 会 neutralise HCl，所以 overall equation 常写：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2COCl + 2NH3 -> CH3CH2CONH2 + NH4Cl}
\]
With methylamine：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2COCl + 2CH3NH2 -> CH3CH2CONHCH3 + CH3NH3Cl}
\]
Ammonia gives unsubstituted primary amide；primary / secondary amine gives N-substituted amide。



Amide formation from an acyl chloride

text:

A polyester chain





Diol and dicarboxylic acid monomers

一个 molecule 同时带有 \(\ce{-OH}\) 和 \(\ce{-COOH}\) 时，称 hydroxycarboxylic acid，也可 self-condense 形成 polyester，例如 2-hydroxybutanoic acid。



Formation of PET





Polyester from a hydroxycarboxylic acid

1,6-diaminohexane；
hexane-1,6-dioic acid（adipic acid）或 hexanedioyl dichloride；
repeat link：\(\ce{-CONH-}\)。

title: 5.6 Organic Synthesis · Topic 20
text:
本页严格按 Pearson Edexcel International Advanced Level Chemistry specification 的 Topic 20: Organic Synthesis（20.1–20.5） 编排，主要依据项目内的 5.6 Organic Synthesis.pdf.pdf。解释采用中文，专业词汇保留 English，便于和 reaction schemes、spectra、practical procedures 及 exam wording 对照。


学完本章后，你应该能够：

deduce empirical、molecular 和 structural formulae from combustion、percentage、functional-group 和 spectral data；
plan reaction schemes of up to four steps，并选择合适 reagents、conditions 和 practical controls；
use magnesium to form Grignard reagents，extend carbon chains with carbon dioxide and carbonyl compounds；
predict properties of unfamiliar organic compounds using known functional groups；
prepare aspirin in Core Practical 16；
explain reflux、washing、solvent extraction、recrystallisation、drying、distillation、steam distillation、melting-point 和 boiling-point techniques。






未知 organic compound 的 structure deduction 可按以下顺序：

用 combustion analysis / elemental percentage composition 求 empirical formula；
用 accurate \(M_r\) 求 molecular formula；
用 functional-group tests、IR、MS 和 NMR 确定 functional groups / carbon skeleton；
组合 evidence，提出并验证 structural formula。

Useful data sources：

combustion analysis；
percentage composition；
characteristic reactions：bromine、dichromate(VI)、Fehling’s / Tollens’、2,4-DNPH、carbonate、iodoform；
IR spectroscopy；
mass spectrometry；
\(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) and \(^1\mathrm{H}\) NMR spectroscopy。







Unknown compound 完全燃烧时，sample 中的 C 进入 \(\ce{CO2}\)，H 进入 \(\ce{H2O}\)。对只含 C、H、O 的 compound：
\[
m(\ce{C})=\frac{12.0}{44.0}\times m(\ce{CO2})
\]
\[
m(\ce{H})=\frac{2.0}{18.0}\times m(\ce{H2O})
\]
然后：

calculate percentage C and H；
percentage O \(=100-\%\ce{C}-\%\ce{H}\)；
divide each percentage by \(A_r\)；
divide all values by smallest；
multiply to obtain whole-number ratio。




Empirical-formula calculation table




Worked example · combustion analysis
一份 \(2.90\ \mathrm{g}\) carbohydrate 完全燃烧，生成 \(6.60\ \mathrm{g}\) \(\ce{CO2}\) 和 \(2.70\ \mathrm{g}\) \(\ce{H2O}\)。
Step 1：mass and percentage of carbon
\[
m(\ce{C})=\frac{12.0}{44.0}\times6.60=1.80\ \mathrm{g}
\]
\[
\%\ce{C}=\frac{1.80}{2.90}\times100=62.1\%
\]
Step 2：mass and percentage of hydrogen
\[
m(\ce{H})=\frac{2.0}{18.0}\times2.70=0.30\ \mathrm{g}
\]
\[
\%\ce{H}=\frac{0.30}{2.90}\times100=10.3\%
\]
Step 3：oxygen and ratio
\[
\%\ce{O}=100-62.1-10.3=27.6\%
\]
Divide by \(12.0\)、\(1.0\)、\(16.0\)，ratio 约为 \(3:6:1\)，所以 empirical formula 是 \(\ce{C3H6O}\)。



Empirical formula 只表示 simplest whole-number ratio。先 calculate empirical-formula mass \(M_{r,\mathrm{emp}}\)，再用：
\[
n=\frac{M_{r,\mathrm{molecular}}}{M_{r,\mathrm{emp}}}
\]
把 empirical formula 的 subscripts 全部乘以 \(n\)。例如 empirical formula \(\ce{C3H6O}\) 的 mass = 58；若 accurate molecular mass = 116，则 molecular formula = \(\ce{C6H12O2}\)。













Evidence / test

proton environments、integration、splitting

Aliphatic reaction pathways





Aromatic reaction pathways





建议使用 backward planning：

从 target molecule 往回找可行 precursor；
若 target 比 starting material 多一个 carbon，考虑 nitrile route 或 Grignard route；
每一步写 reagent、condition 和 reaction type；
检查是否超过 four steps，是否有 incompatible functional groups；
加入 separation / purification 和 hazard controls。

Example：chloroethane \(→\) ethanoic acid：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2Cl ->[aq. NaOH][reflux] CH3CH2OH ->[K2Cr2O7/H2SO4][reflux] CH3COOH}
\]
Example：ethene \(→\) 1-aminopropane：
\[
\ce{CH2=CH2 ->[HCl] CH3CH2Cl ->[KCN/ethanol][reflux] CH3CH2CN ->[LiAlH4][dry\ ether] CH3CH2CH2NH2}
\]



Chloroethane to ethanoic acid pathway





Ethene to aminopropane pathway





预测 unfamiliar compound properties 时，把 structure 与 known functional-group behaviour 连接：

more hydrogen bonding \(→\) higher boiling temperature / water solubility；
longer hydrocarbon chain \(→\) stronger London forces but usually lower water solubility；
ionic / zwitterionic species \(→\) high melting temperature and water solubility；
aromatic delocalisation \(→\) electrophilic substitution preference；
carbonyl / carboxyl / amine groups \(→\) characteristic acid-base / redox / nucleophilic reactions。

Hazard control 要基于 data：volatile / flammable liquids 使用 no naked flame；corrosive acid / alkali 使用 goggles、gloves 和 fume hood；toxic / irritant compounds 限制 exposure；pressure、vacuum 和 hot glassware 需要 additional controls。






Halogenoalkane 在 dry ether 中与 magnesium 反应，形成 Grignard reagent：
\[
\ce{R-X + Mg ->[dry\ ether] R-MgX}
\]
Grignard reagent 中的 R group 可看作具有 carbanion-like character，因而是 strong nucleophile / base。Reaction mixture 必须保持 dry，因为 water 会 protonate and destroy the reagent：
\[
\ce{R-MgX + H2O -> RH + Mg(OH)X}
\]
Carbonyl / carbon dioxide reaction 通常先形成 magnesium salt，随后加入 dilute acid hydrolysis / protonation，得到 organic product。



Methanal \(→\) primary alcohol
\[
\ce{R-MgX + HCHO ->[dry\ ether] RCH2OMgX ->[H3O+] RCH2OH}
\]
Aldehyde \(→\) secondary alcohol
\[
\ce{R-MgX + R'CHO ->[dry\ ether] R'CH(OMgX)R ->[H3O+] R'CH(OH)R}
\]
Ketone \(→\) tertiary alcohol
\[
\ce{R-MgX + R'2CO ->[dry\ ether] R'2C(OMgX)R ->[H3O+] R'2C(OH)R}
\]
例如 ethylmagnesium iodide 与 propanone 反应，acid work-up 后形成 2-methylbutan-2-ol。Mechanism detail 不要求，但 product class 和 dry ether / acid work-up 必须准确。



Grignard reagent 与 carbon dioxide 反应，在 work-up 后形成 carboxylic acid，并使 carbon chain 增加 one carbon：
\[
\ce{R-MgX + CO2 -> RCOO-MgX ->[H3O+] RCOOH}
\]
例如：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2MgI + CO2 -> CH3CH2COOH}
\]
产品是 propanoic acid，starting ethyl group 的 carbon chain 增加了 carbon dioxide 的 one carbon。






Aspirin 是 2-ethanoyloxybenzoic acid / acetylsalicylic acid，可由 salicylic acid 的 phenolic \(\ce{-OH}\) 与 ethanoic anhydride 发生 ethanoylation / esterification 制备：
\[
\ce{C6H4(OH)COOH + (CH3CO)2O -> C6H4(OCOCH3)COOH + CH3COOH}
\]
Typical practical sequence：

weigh salicylic acid；
add ethanoic anhydride 和 phosphoric acid catalyst；
warm in a water bath，stir to complete reaction；
add cold water to hydrolyse excess ethanoic anhydride and precipitate aspirin；
cool in ice，vacuum filter crystals；
wash with a small amount of cold water；
recrystallise，dry and determine melting temperature；
calculate percentage yield and compare melting range with data-book value。

Safety：ethanoic anhydride is corrosive / lachrymatory，acid catalyst is corrosive，hot water bath 和 vacuum filtration require eye protection and controlled handling。









Simple distillation 用 boiling-temperature difference 分离 liquid product。适用于 reaction 不完全或 product 与 reactants / solvent mixture 共存的情况。
以 primary alcohol oxidation 为例：aldehyde 的 boiling point lower than alcohol，因此边形成边 distil off，减少进一步 oxidation：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2OH + [O] -> CH3CHO + H2O}
\]
要点：anti-bumping granules、thermometer bulb 位于 vapour path、condenser water enters from bottom、controlled heating、在 target boiling point \(\pm2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\) 范围收集 fraction。



Simple distillation to collect an aldehyde








Heating under reflux 让 reaction mixture 在 boiling temperature 长时间加热，vapour 在 vertical condenser 中 condense 回 flask，因此 reactants、products 和 solvent 不会大量 loss。
适用 examples：primary alcohol 完全 oxidise 为 carboxylic acid、esterification、hydrolysis。与 distillation 的目的相反：

distillation：separate and collect volatile product；
reflux：keep all components in reaction flask，allow reaction to proceed more completely。

使用 heating mantle / water bath，不要对 flammable organic liquids 直接使用 naked Bunsen flame。



Reflux apparatus








Steam distillation 用 steam 带出 an organic liquid that is immiscible with water。Organic liquid 与 water vapour 一起 distil at a temperature below its normal boiling point，减少 thermal decomposition。Distillate 常 cloudy，随后用 separating funnel separate layers。






Reaction mixture 常含 water、acid / alkali 和 organic product。用 water 或 aqueous sodium carbonate solution washing 可以 remove soluble impurities / neutralise acid。
Separating-funnel procedure：

transfer mixture into funnel，fit stopper；
invert and gently shake，frequently open stopcock to release pressure；
allow immiscible layers to separate；
identify layer by density or small water-addition test；
drain lower layer through stopcock，keep correct organic layer；
repeat wash if needed。

Sodium carbonate + acid 可能 produce \(\ce{CO2}\)，所以必须 vent frequently and open stopcock slowly。



Separating funnel solvent extraction





Drying agents 是 anhydrous inorganic salts，会吸收 organic layer 中 traces of water：

anhydrous calcium chloride：常用于 hydrocarbons；
anhydrous calcium / magnesium sulfate：general-purpose drying agents。

Add small portions and swirl：若 drying agent clumps，仍有 water；继续加入直到部分 fine powder remains free-flowing。Dry liquid 应 clear，然后 decant or filter off drying agent。



Recrystallisation 用于 purify an impure solid：

choose solvent in which product soluble when hot but only slightly soluble when cold；
use minimum hot solvent to dissolve solid；
hot-filter insoluble impurities if necessary；
allow solution to cool slowly，pure crystals form；
cool further in ice，vacuum-filter with Buchner funnel；
wash crystals with small amount of cold solvent，dry。

Slow cooling gives larger, better-defined crystals；repeating recrystallisation increases purity but decreases percentage yield。



Recrystallisation and Buchner filtration








Melting temperature 可用于 identify solid 和 assess purity：

pure solid：sharp, narrow melting range，接近 data-book value；
impure solid：lower melting temperature and broader melting range。

Practical technique：sample finely powdered and completely dry，pack into capillary，heat slowly，record temperature when melting begins and when fully liquid。Report as a range，而不是 single value；至少 repeat measurements。



Melting-point test in an oil bath





Melting-point test using a Thiele tube





Digital melting-point station





Liquid 的 boiling temperature 通过 distillation 确定，并与 literature / database value 比较：

pure liquid 通常在 narrow temperature 附近 boil；
impurities 可能使 apparent boiling temperature higher，或造成 broad boiling range；
distillation fraction 的 thermometer reading 应在 vapour pass into condenser 的位置测量。







面对 synthesis question：

draw starting structure and target structure；
compare carbon count，找出是否需要 nitrile / Grignard chain extension；
identify one functional-group change per step；
choose reagent、solvent、temperature、catalyst and work-up；
keep within four steps；
include purification and hazard controls；
check all structures、charges、carbon count、oxidation direction 和 product class。

Synthesis answer 的每一步都应有 reactant \(→\) product + reagent / condition + reaction type，不要只写 reagent list。






能由 combustion data 求 elemental percentages、empirical formula 和 molecular formula。
能结合 functional-group tests、IR、MS、\(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) NMR 和 \(^1\mathrm{H}\) NMR deduce structure。
能计划 up to four-step reaction scheme，并写完整 reagents / conditions / reaction types。
能使用 nitrile route 或 Grignard route 增加 carbon-chain length。
能写 Grignard reagent preparation、carbonyl additions 和 \(\ce{CO2}\) carboxylic-acid synthesis。
能解释 reflux 与 distillation 的不同目的，并画 / label apparatus。
能描述 washing、separating funnel、drying 和 solvent extraction 的操作与 safety。
能描述 recrystallisation、Buchner filtration 和 yield-purity trade-off。
能用 melting / boiling temperature 判断 purity and identity，并报告 range。
能完成 Core Practical 16 aspirin preparation、percentage yield、melting range 和 risk controls。

title: 5.6 Organic Synthesis · Topic 20
text:
Aspirin 是 2-ethanoyloxybenzoic acid / acetylsalicylic acid，可由 salicylic acid 的 phenolic \(\ce{-OH}\) 与 ethanoic anhydride 发生 ethanoylation / esterification 制备：
\[
\ce{C6H4(OH)COOH + (CH3CO)2O -> C6H4(OCOCH3)COOH + CH3COOH}
\]
Typical practical sequence：

weigh salicylic acid；
add ethanoic anhydride 和 phosphoric acid catalyst；
warm in a water bath，stir to complete reaction；
add cold water to hydrolyse excess ethanoic anhydride and precipitate aspirin；
cool in ice，vacuum filter crystals；
wash with a small amount of cold water；
recrystallise，dry and determine melting temperature；
calculate percentage yield and compare melting range with data-book value。

Safety：ethanoic anhydride is corrosive / lachrymatory，acid catalyst is corrosive，hot water bath 和 vacuum filtration require eye protection and controlled handling。
crumbs: Unit 5 · Advanced inorganic and organic chemistry

title: 5.6 Organic Synthesis · Topic 20
text:
Simple distillation 用 boiling-temperature difference 分离 liquid product。适用于 reaction 不完全或 product 与 reactants / solvent mixture 共存的情况。
以 primary alcohol oxidation 为例：aldehyde 的 boiling point lower than alcohol，因此边形成边 distil off，减少进一步 oxidation：
\[
\ce{CH3CH2OH + [O] -> CH3CHO + H2O}
\]
要点：anti-bumping granules、thermometer bulb 位于 vapour path、condenser water enters from bottom、controlled heating、在 target boiling point \(\pm2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\) 范围收集 fraction。



Simple distillation to collect an aldehyde








Heating under reflux 让 reaction mixture 在 boiling temperature 长时间加热，vapour 在 vertical condenser 中 condense 回 flask，因此 reactants、products 和 solvent 不会大量 loss。
适用 examples：primary alcohol 完全 oxidise 为 carboxylic acid、esterification、hydrolysis。与 distillation 的目的相反：

distillation：separate and collect volatile product；
reflux：keep all components in reaction flask，allow reaction to proceed more completely。

使用 heating mantle / water bath，不要对 flammable organic liquids 直接使用 naked Bunsen flame。



Reflux apparatus








Steam distillation 用 steam 带出 an organic liquid that is immiscible with water。Organic liquid 与 water vapour 一起 distil at a temperature below its normal boiling point，减少 thermal decomposition。Distillate 常 cloudy，随后用 separating funnel separate layers。
crumbs: Unit 5 · Advanced inorganic and organic chemistry

title: 5.6 Organic Synthesis · Topic 20
text:
Reaction mixture 常含 water、acid / alkali 和 organic product。用 water 或 aqueous sodium carbonate solution washing 可以 remove soluble impurities / neutralise acid。
Separating-funnel procedure：

transfer mixture into funnel，fit stopper；
invert and gently shake，frequently open stopcock to release pressure；
allow immiscible layers to separate；
identify layer by density or small water-addition test；
drain lower layer through stopcock，keep correct organic layer；
repeat wash if needed。

Sodium carbonate + acid 可能 produce \(\ce{CO2}\)，所以必须 vent frequently and open stopcock slowly。



Separating funnel solvent extraction





Drying agents 是 anhydrous inorganic salts，会吸收 organic layer 中 traces of water：

anhydrous calcium chloride：常用于 hydrocarbons；
anhydrous calcium / magnesium sulfate：general-purpose drying agents。

Add small portions and swirl：若 drying agent clumps，仍有 water；继续加入直到部分 fine powder remains free-flowing。Dry liquid 应 clear，然后 decant or filter off drying agent。



Recrystallisation 用于 purify an impure solid：

choose solvent in which product soluble when hot but only slightly soluble when cold；
use minimum hot solvent to dissolve solid；
hot-filter insoluble impurities if necessary；
allow solution to cool slowly，pure crystals form；
cool further in ice，vacuum-filter with Buchner funnel；
wash crystals with small amount of cold solvent，dry。

Slow cooling gives larger, better-defined crystals；repeating recrystallisation increases purity but decreases percentage yield。



Recrystallisation and Buchner filtration
crumbs: Unit 5 · Advanced inorganic and organic chemistry

title: 5.6 Organic Synthesis · Topic 20
text:
Melting temperature 可用于 identify solid 和 assess purity：

pure solid：sharp, narrow melting range，接近 data-book value；
impure solid：lower melting temperature and broader melting range。

Practical technique：sample finely powdered and completely dry，pack into capillary，heat slowly，record temperature when melting begins and when fully liquid。Report as a range，而不是 single value；至少 repeat measurements。



Melting-point test in an oil bath





Melting-point test using a Thiele tube





Digital melting-point station





Liquid 的 boiling temperature 通过 distillation 确定，并与 literature / database value 比较：

pure liquid 通常在 narrow temperature 附近 boil；
impurities 可能使 apparent boiling temperature higher，或造成 broad boiling range；
distillation fraction 的 thermometer reading 应在 vapour pass into condenser 的位置测量。
crumbs: Unit 5 · Advanced inorganic and organic chemistry

title: 5.6 Organic Synthesis · Topic 20
text:
面对 synthesis question：

draw starting structure and target structure；
compare carbon count，找出是否需要 nitrile / Grignard chain extension；
identify one functional-group change per step；
choose reagent、solvent、temperature、catalyst and work-up；
keep within four steps；
include purification and hazard controls；
check all structures、charges、carbon count、oxidation direction 和 product class。

Synthesis answer 的每一步都应有 reactant \(→\) product + reagent / condition + reaction type，不要只写 reagent list。
crumbs: Unit 5 · Advanced inorganic and organic chemistry

title: 5.6 Organic Synthesis · Topic 20
text:
能由 combustion data 求 elemental percentages、empirical formula 和 molecular formula。
能结合 functional-group tests、IR、MS、\(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) NMR 和 \(^1\mathrm{H}\) NMR deduce structure。
能计划 up to four-step reaction scheme，并写完整 reagents / conditions / reaction types。
能使用 nitrile route 或 Grignard route 增加 carbon-chain length。
能写 Grignard reagent preparation、carbonyl additions 和 \(\ce{CO2}\) carboxylic-acid synthesis。
能解释 reflux 与 distillation 的不同目的，并画 / label apparatus。
能描述 washing、separating funnel、drying 和 solvent extraction 的操作与 safety。
能描述 recrystallisation、Buchner filtration 和 yield-purity trade-off。
能用 melting / boiling temperature 判断 purity and identity，并报告 range。
能完成 Core Practical 16 aspirin preparation、percentage yield、melting range 和 risk controls。

title: 6.1 Advanced Physical Chemistry Core Practicals
text:
本页对应 6.1 Advanced Physical Chemistry Core Practicals.pdf.pdf，整理 Pearson Edexcel International Advanced Level Chemistry 的五个 advanced physical chemistry core practicals。专业词汇保留 English，重点放在 method、control variables、data processing、uncertainty、evaluation 和 exam wording。










Core Practical
Main idea
Main data treatment




9a · Titrimetric method
Follow iodine concentration during a reaction
Titre, concentration-time graph, reaction order


9b · Iodine clock reaction
Use a sudden blue-black colour change as a timer
Rate ∝ 1/t, rate-concentration graph


10 · Activation energy
Compare rate constants at different temperatures
Arrhenius plot, gradient = -Ea/R


11 · Finding Ka
Titrate a weak acid and locate half-equivalence point
pH = pKa, Ka = 10^-pKa


12 · Electrochemical cells
Measure the EMF of metal / metal-ion half-cells
Ecell = Epositive - Enegative






学完本页后，你应该能够：

plan a valid practical and identify independent、dependent and control variables；
select suitable apparatus、reagents、indicators and measurement intervals；
process raw results into concentration、rate、k、Ea、Ka or Ecell；
explain anomalous results、repeat measurements、uncertainty 和 improvements；
write a conclusion using evidence from a graph or calculated value。






Iodine reacts with propanone in acidic solution：
\[
\ce{CH3COCH3(aq) + I2(aq) -> CH3COCH2I(aq) + H+(aq) + I-(aq)}
\]
在 experiment 中，propanone 和 sulfuric acid 用 large excess，因而它们的 concentration 在每一次取样期间近似 constant。通过在不同 time withdraw a fixed volume reaction mixture，再用 sodium thiosulfate titration 测量剩余 iodine concentration，可以研究 reaction rate。
Titration reaction：
\[
\ce{2S2O3^{2-}(aq) + I2(aq) -> 2I-(aq) + S4O6^{2-}(aq)}
\]
Starch 是 indicator；endpoint 附近的 blue-black colour disappears。加入 sodium hydrogencarbonate 可以使 withdrawn sample 中的 reaction stop，避免 titration 期间 iodine 继续消耗。



Titrimetric results table





Zero-order concentration-time graph






Mix measured volumes of aqueous propanone and sulfuric acid in a beaker。
Add a measured volume of iodine solution and start the clock immediately。
Using a pipette，withdraw a fixed volume at regular time intervals。
Add sodium hydrogencarbonate to stop the reaction in the withdrawn portion。
Titrate against standard sodium thiosulfate using starch；record the titre。
Repeat the sampling and titration at least five times，including an early and a late time point。





titre → moles of S2O3^2-；
use the stoichiometric ratio 2:1 to calculate moles of iodine；
divide by the aliquot volume to obtain [I2]；
plot [I2] against time and inspect linearity；
a straight line with constant negative gradient is evidence for zero-order behaviour with respect to iodine。





use the same pipette、burette、aliquot volume and thiosulfate concentration throughout；
record the time when sodium hydrogencarbonate is added，not only the time when the titration begins；
keep the clock running continuously；
rinse the pipette with reaction mixture and the burette with thiosulfate solution；
read the meniscus at eye level and add titrant dropwise near the endpoint；
repeat titres until concordant values are obtained；
a delay between sampling and quenching makes the calculated iodine concentration too low。







The main redox reaction is：
\[
\ce{H2O2(aq) + 2I-(aq) + 2H+(aq) -> I2(aq) + 2H2O(l)}
\]
Sodium thiosulfate removes iodine as it forms：
\[
\ce{2S2O3^{2-}(aq) + I2(aq) -> 2I-(aq) + S4O6^{2-}(aq)}
\]
只要 thiosulfate remains，starch 不会呈现 blue-black。固定 amount of thiosulfate 被消耗完后，excess iodine suddenly forms the starch-iodine complex，出现 sharp colour change。因为到 endpoint 所产生的 iodine amount fixed，
\[
\text{rate} \propto \frac{1}{t}
\]
其中 t 是从 mixing 到 blue-black endpoint 的 time。



Iodine clock reaction setup





改变 potassium iodide concentration，同时用 water 补足体积，使 total volume、acid、hydrogen peroxide、thiosulfate 和 starch 的 amounts 保持 constant。可以使用以下 plan：



Iodine clock planning table



Measure all solutions in separate measuring cylinders or pipettes。
Add hydrogen peroxide to start the reaction and start the timer at the same moment。
Mix rapidly and stop the timer when the sudden blue-black colour appears。
Repeat each condition and calculate a mean time。
Calculate 1/t and plot rate against [I-] or [KI]。




Iodine clock specimen results





Rate-concentration graph for iodine clock reaction






use a thermostatically controlled water bath if temperature is a variable；
use the same observer or a colorimeter to reduce endpoint subjectivity；
start timing immediately after mixing and use consistent mixing；
do not change total volume when changing one reactant concentration；
a straight line through the origin for rate against concentration supports first-order dependence；
scatter around the line may arise from human reaction time、incomplete mixing or uncertainty in measuring small volumes。







The reaction used involves bromide and bromate(V) ions：
\[
\ce{BrO3^- + 5Br^- + 6H+ -> 3Br2 + 3H2O}
\]
The bromine reacts with phenol：
\[
\ce{C6H5OH + 3Br2 -> C6H2Br3OH + 3HBr}
\]
Methyl red / methyl orange can indicate the endpoint because bromine eventually bleaches the indicator. At a fixed composition，the same visible endpoint corresponds to approximately the same extent of reaction，so a shorter time means a larger rate constant。




Place a measured phenol solution and bromide / bromate solution in separate boiling tubes。
Add indicator and equilibrate both tubes in a water bath at a measured temperature。
Mix rapidly，start the stopwatch，and record the time for the indicator to disappear。
Repeat at several temperatures，for example 310、335、360 and 385 K。
Treat k as proportional to 1/t when the same endpoint and concentrations are used。




Activation-energy results table





The Arrhenius equation is：
\[
k=Ae^{-E_a/(RT)}
\]
Taking natural logarithms：
\[
\ln k=-\frac{E_a}{R}\frac{1}{T}+\ln A
\]
Plot ln k on the y-axis against 1/T on the x-axis：



Arrhenius plot


\[
\text{gradient}=-\frac{E_a}{R}
\]
因此：
\[
E_a=-R\times\text{gradient}
\]



Activation-energy gradient calculation





Activation-energy calculation


Intercept 是 ln A；选取 graph 上的 point 并代入 equation 可计算 A：



Activation-energy intercept





Activation-energy final calculation






use a water bath rather than direct flame to obtain more uniform temperature；
measure the actual temperature of the reaction mixture，not only the bath temperature；
allow both solutions to reach the target temperature before mixing；
use a lid or boiling tube stopper where appropriate to reduce evaporation；
use a temperature range large enough to produce a measurable change in t；
keep concentrations、volumes、indicator amount and endpoint criterion constant；
repeat each temperature and calculate a mean；
a non-linear Arrhenius plot suggests temperature control problems，timing error or a change in mechanism。







For a weak monoprotic acid HA：
\[
\ce{HA(aq) <=> H+(aq) + A-(aq)}
\]
\[
K_a=\frac{[H^+][A^-]}{[HA]}
\]
At the half-equivalence point，half of the original HA has been neutralised，so [HA] = [A-] and：
\[
K_a=[H^+],\qquad pK_a=pH
\]



Ka expression






Pipette a measured volume of weak acid into a beaker and add distilled water if needed。
Calibrate the pH meter with suitable buffer solutions。
Add standard alkali from a burette in small portions，stirring after each addition。
Record pH and volume of alkali；use smaller additions near the steep section。
Plot pH against volume of base added。
Locate the equivalence point；the half-equivalence volume is V/2。
Read the pH at V/2 and calculate pKa and Ka。




Weak-acid titration curve and half-equivalence point






calibrate the pH meter before use and rinse the electrode with distilled water；
remove drops from the outside of the burette tip and record the initial / final readings consistently；
wait for the pH reading to stabilise after each addition；
use a magnetic stirrer or consistent manual stirring；
take closely spaced readings around the equivalence region；
carbon dioxide absorption、poor calibration and overshooting the equivalence point can shift the curve；
repeat the titration to obtain a concordant equivalence volume。







An electrochemical cell consists of two half-cells connected by an external circuit and a salt bridge. Typical equipment includes：

two beakers and metal electrodes such as Zn、Cu、Fe or Ag；
approximately 1.0 mol dm^-3 solutions containing the relevant metal ions；
a salt bridge soaked in saturated KNO3(aq)；
wires with crocodile clips；
a high-resistance voltmeter。




Electrochemical cell setup


The salt bridge completes the ionic circuit and maintains electrical neutrality；the high-resistance voltmeter measures potential difference while drawing negligible current。




Polish the metal electrodes and rinse them with distilled water。
Place each electrode in its corresponding metal-ion solution。
Connect the half-cells using the salt bridge and voltmeter。
Record the sign and magnitude of the stable EMF。
Repeat with different combinations of half-cells。

For a spontaneous cell：
\[
E_{\mathrm{cell}}=E_{\mathrm{positive\ electrode}}-E_{\mathrm{negative\ electrode}}
\]
The more positive reduction potential is the positive electrode / cathode，where reduction occurs；the other is the negative electrode / anode，where oxidation occurs。



Electrochemical EMF results table






use clean electrodes with a reproducible surface area；
use the same solution concentration and temperature for comparison；
ensure the salt bridge makes good contact with both solutions but does not mix them excessively；
do not use an ammeter or low-resistance circuit because current flow changes the measured potential；
wait for a stable reading and repeat each cell combination；
a contaminated electrode、different ion concentration、poor salt-bridge contact or liquid junction potential can cause anomalous EMF；
wear eye protection and handle metal-ion solutions according to their hazard information。








回答 practical question 时按以下顺序组织：

Method：写 apparatus、reagent、measurement and endpoint；
Variables：明确 independent、dependent 和 control variables；
Data：列出 raw readings、units、repeat values 和 mean；
Processing：展示 one sample calculation，保持 significant figures；
Graph：label axes、units、scale、best-fit line and gradient triangle；
Conclusion：用 graph / calculation 的 evidence 回答题目；
Evaluation：指出具体 systematic / random error，并给出可执行 improvement。





rate = 1/t only when the same fixed endpoint amount is used；
gradient = -Ea/R for an Arrhenius plot；
at half-equivalence，pH = pKa；
Ka = 10^-pKa；
Ecell = Epositive - Enegative。








能写 Core Practical 9a 的 iodine / thiosulfate equations，并解释 quenching。
能由 titre calculate iodine concentration，并画 concentration-time graph。
能解释 iodine clock 的 sudden endpoint 及 rate ∝ 1/t。
能设计 concentration table，保持 total volume 和 control variables constant。
能用 Arrhenius equation、gradient 和 intercept calculate Ea 与 A。
能解释 water bath、repeat readings、temperature equilibration 的重要性。
能从 weak-acid titration curve 找 half-equivalence point，calculate pKa 和 Ka。
能解释 pH-meter calibration、small volume increments 和 stable readings。
能画 electrochemical cell，识别 anode、cathode、electron flow 和 salt bridge function。
能用 Ecell = Epositive - Enegative 处理 EMF data。
能写出明确的 uncertainty、error source、safety precaution 和 improvement。

use the same solution concentration and temperature for comparison；
ensure the salt bridge makes good contact with both solutions but does not mix them excessively；
do not use an ammeter or low-resistance circuit because current flow changes the measured potential；
wait for a stable reading and repeat each cell combination；
a contaminated electrode、different ion concentration、poor salt-bridge contact or liquid junction potential can cause anomalous EMF；
wear eye protection and handle metal-ion solutions according to their hazard information。

text:

Method：写 apparatus、reagent、measurement and endpoint；

rate = 1/t only when the same fixed endpoint amount is used；

at half-equivalence，pH = pKa；
Ka = 10^-pKa；

title: 6.2 Advanced Inorganic - Organic Chemistry Core Practicals
text:
本页对应 6.2 Advanced Inorganic - Organic Chemistry Core Practicals.pdf.pdf，整理 Pearson Edexcel International Advanced Level Chemistry 的 advanced inorganic / organic core practicals。专业词汇保留 English，重点覆盖 observations、ionic equations、stoichiometry、purification、yield、melting point 和 safety。










Section
Core Practical
Main skills




6.2.1
13a · Iron(II) and manganate(VII) titration
Redox titration and percentage purity


6.2.2
13b · Thiosulfate and iodine titration
Iodometric titration and standardisation


6.2.3
14 · Preparation of a transition-metal complex
Complex formation, filtration and yield


6.2.4
15 · A-level qualitative analysis
Cation, anion and organic functional-group tests


6.2.5
16 · Aspirin preparation
Synthesis, recrystallisation and melting point






学完本页后，你应该能够：

select a suitable titration reagent and explain why an acid is or is not suitable；
identify oxidation / reduction species and write ionic equations；
calculate concentration、moles、percentage purity、percentage yield and atom economy；
prepare a transition-metal complex safely and assess the product；
distinguish common inorganic ions and organic functional groups from observations；
prepare aspirin by reflux / heating，purify it by recrystallisation，并用 melting point 判断 purity。






Acidified potassium manganate(VII) is a strong oxidising agent. In acidic solution，purple MnO4- is reduced to almost colourless Mn2+：
\[
\ce{MnO4^- + 8H+ + 5e^- -> Mn^{2+} + 4H2O}
\]
Iron(II) is oxidised to iron(III)：
\[
\ce{Fe^{2+} -> Fe^{3+} + e^-}
\]
Overall ionic equation：
\[
\ce{MnO4^- + 8H+ + 5Fe^{2+} -> Mn^{2+} + 4H2O + 5Fe^{3+}}
\]
No separate indicator is required because acidified manganate(VII) is self-indicating. The endpoint is the first permanent pale pink colour that remains after swirling。




Rinse the burette with manganate(VII) solution and fill it，removing air bubbles from the jet。
Pipette a measured volume of the iron(II) solution into a conical flask。
Add an excess of dilute sulfuric acid。
Titrate with manganate(VII)，swirling continuously and adding dropwise near the endpoint。
Repeat until concordant titres are obtained。

Sulfuric acid is suitable. Hydrochloric acid can be oxidised to chlorine；nitric acid is itself an oxidising agent；ethanoic acid is too weak；concentrated sulfuric acid may oxidise the substance being analysed。



Acid selection for manganate(VII) titration





Iron(II) and manganate(VII) titration setup





From the titre：
\[
n(\ce{MnO4^-})=cV
\]
Use the 1:5 ratio to find n(Fe2+)，then calculate the concentration and mass of the iron-containing substance. Percentage purity：
\[
\%\ \text{purity}=\frac{\text{mass of pure substance}}{\text{mass of impure sample}}\times100
\]




rinse the flask with distilled water，not with the analyte，so no extra moles of analyte are introduced；
use a white tile to see the pale-pink endpoint clearly；
read the burette at eye level and record to the correct resolution；
do not overshoot the endpoint；
repeat until two or more titres are concordant；
manganate(VII) decomposes in light，so use freshly standardised solution where required。







Iodine is reduced by thiosulfate：
\[
\ce{I2 + 2S2O3^{2-} -> 2I^- + S4O6^{2-}}
\]
The iodine solution is usually titrated using sodium thiosulfate and starch. Starch is added near the endpoint，when the solution is pale yellow，because a high iodine concentration can make the starch complex difficult to reverse。
The procedure usually involves adding excess iodide to an oxidising sample，liberating iodine，then titrating the iodine with standard thiosulfate. Use the equation and stoichiometric ratios to determine the amount of oxidising species in the original sample。




Calculate moles of thiosulfate from n = cV。
Use the 2:1 ratio to find moles of I2。
Use the reaction equation to find moles of the original oxidising agent。
Convert to concentration、mass or percentage purity。

Use a conical flask on a white tile，swirl continuously，and add starch only close to the endpoint. If iodine is lost by evaporation or the flask is not stoppered when required，the calculated amount of oxidising agent will be too low。






The general workflow is：

calculate the required stoichiometric amounts of metal salt and ligand；
dissolve the reactants and control pH / temperature；
mix in the specified order and allow the complex to form；
cool the mixture if necessary and collect crystals by filtration；
wash the crystals with a suitable small volume of cold solvent；
dry to constant mass and calculate percentage yield。

For a complex such as [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+，the ligand donates lone pairs to the central metal ion through dative covalent bonds. The coordination number、oxidation state and ligand identity should be checked when writing the product formula。



Buchner filtration during complex preparation





\[
\%\ \text{yield}=\frac{\text{actual mass of dry product}}{\text{theoretical mass}}\times100
\]
Possible causes of a low yield include incomplete reaction、side reactions、loss during transfer / filtration、product remaining dissolved and wet crystals. Drying to constant mass is important because residual solvent gives an artificially high mass。
Safety controls should include goggles、gloves、fume cupboard where ammonia is used、care with hot solutions and appropriate disposal of metal-ion waste。




Qualitative analysis identifies ions or functional groups from reagent + condition + observation + conclusion. A conclusion should not be based on colour alone；use confirmatory tests where possible。


For ammonium ions，add aqueous sodium hydroxide and warm gently：
\[
\ce{NH4+ + OH- -> NH3 + H2O}
\]
Ammonia turns damp red litmus paper blue. Avoid directly smelling the gas；use wafting only when instructed。
Group 2 ions can be compared using ammonia solution、excess sodium hydroxide and excess sulfuric acid：



Group 2 ion qualitative-analysis results





Ammonium-ion test





Acidify the sample with dilute nitric acid and add aqueous silver nitrate：
\[
\ce{Ag+ + Cl- -> AgCl(s)}
\]
\[
\ce{Ag+ + Br- -> AgBr(s)}
\]
\[
\ce{Ag+ + I- -> AgI(s)}
\]
Observations：AgCl white，AgBr cream，AgI yellow。Ammonia solubility confirms the identity：AgCl dissolves in dilute ammonia，AgBr dissolves in concentrated ammonia，AgI remains insoluble。



Halide precipitate colours





Silver chloride ammonia test





Silver bromide ammonia test





Carbonate ions react with dilute acid to produce carbon dioxide：
\[
\ce{CO3^{2-} + 2H+ -> CO2 + H2O}
\]
Bubble the gas through limewater；a milky precipitate of calcium carbonate confirms CO2：
\[
\ce{CO2 + Ca(OH)2 -> CaCO3(s) + H2O}
\]



Carbonate test





Carbon dioxide limewater confirmation


For sulfate ions，acidify with dilute hydrochloric acid and add barium chloride：
\[
\ce{Ba^{2+} + SO4^{2-} -> BaSO4(s)}
\]
The white barium sulfate precipitate is insoluble in dilute acids。



Sulfate-ion test





Alkene：bromine water is decolourised because bromine adds across the C=C bond。



Alkene bromine-water test


Aldehyde / ketone：2,4-DNPH gives an orange precipitate with a carbonyl compound。



2,4-DNPH carbonyl test


Aldehyde：Tollens reagent gives a silver mirror；the aldehyde is oxidised to a carboxylic acid / carboxylate。



Tollens silver-mirror test


Fehling’s solution gives an opaque red precipitate of copper(I) oxide with an aldehyde；a ketone gives no positive result under these conditions。



Fehling test


Transition-metal ions can also be identified from characteristic colours and changes in oxidation state：



Transition-metal colour changes








Aspirin（2-acetoxybenzoic acid）is prepared by reacting salicylic acid with ethanoic anhydride，using an acid catalyst：
\[
\ce{C7H6O3 + (CH3CO)2O -> C9H8O4 + CH3COOH}
\]
The reaction mixture is heated in a hot-water bath，then aspirin is isolated by cooling、recrystallisation and suction filtration。



Heating the aspirin reaction mixture






Dissolve the crude product in the minimum volume of hot solvent。
Filter hot if insoluble impurities remain。
Allow the filtrate to cool slowly so purer crystals form。
Cool in ice if necessary，then collect crystals using a Buchner funnel。
Wash with a small amount of cold solvent and dry thoroughly。




Aspirin recrystallisation and Buchner filtration


Percentage yield：
\[
\%\ \text{yield}=\frac{\text{mass of purified aspirin}}{\text{theoretical mass}}×100
\]
Losses can occur through incomplete reaction、transfer、filtration and solubility of aspirin in the cold solvent. Too much solvent gives a low recovery because more product remains dissolved。



Pure aspirin has a sharp melting point close to the accepted data-booklet value. Impurities usually lower and broaden the melting range。Use a small, dry, finely powdered sample packed into a melting-point tube。



Aspirin melting point oil bath





Aspirin Thiele-tube apparatus





Digital melting-point station


Record the temperature when the first liquid appears and when the sample is completely liquid. Heat slowly near the expected melting point to reduce temperature lag and overshoot。







Every practical answer should identify reagent、condition、observation、equation and conclusion. Include units in all titre、mass、volume、temperature and EMF readings；show one sample calculation；repeat measurements where possible。




endpoint overshoot: add dropwise near the endpoint and use a white tile；
contaminated glassware or electrodes: rinse with the correct solution and use clean equipment；
product loss: use quantitative transfer and minimum cold wash solvent；
wet crystals: dry to constant mass before calculating yield；
impure product: recrystallise and compare melting range with the accepted value；
unsafe volatile / corrosive reagents: use a fume cupboard、goggles、gloves and suitable waste containers。








能写 MnO4- / Fe2+ redox equations and calculate percentage purity。
能解释 sulfuric acid suitable、hydrochloric / nitric / ethanoic acid unsuitable 的原因。
能用 thiosulfate : iodine stoichiometry 处理 iodometric titration。
能写 transition-metal complex 的 formula、coordination number、yield 和 evaluation。
能按 reagent + condition + observation + conclusion 完成 qualitative analysis。
能区分 AgCl、AgBr、AgI 的 colour 和 ammonia solubility。
能确认 ammonium、carbonate、sulfate、alkene、carbonyl、aldehyde 和 carboxylic acid。
能写 aspirin preparation、recrystallisation、Buchner filtration、yield 和 melting-point purity test。
能指出具体 error source、uncertainty、safety precaution 和 improvement。
